tools.name: fraggate_list

tools.name: fraggate_describe

tools.name: fraggate_verify

tools.name: mesh_disable

tools.name: mesh_join

tools.name: mesh_heartbeat

tools.name: mesh_broadcast
tools.description: Register the SHA-256 of a local file as a hash receipt — never a publish or upload path. Use this when the operator already holds a local file and wants only its hash recorded. Do not use it for uploading bytes, publishing video, sending mail, or joining a mesh node; use local qnm-node/ anon-broadca

tools.name: chainlock_append
tools.description: Append one fact-bearing stamp to a local ChainLock chain (CL-WP-0.4). Grounded write — not a tip read, not AKM observe, not a LOCKSET seal. Fabric, not Softwares-tab. No Node Gate. Use this when you have a concrete fact to stamp onto a named chain. Do not use it for reading the tip, adaptive memory

tools.name: chainlock_tip
tools.description: Read only the live tip card of one local ChainLock chain — not depth recall and not LOCKSET verify. Use this when you need the current tip of a named chain. Do not use it for depth-0–5 grounded recall, LOCKSET verify, or adaptive memory explain; use chainlock_recall, chainlock_verify, or memory_get

tools.name: chainlock_recall
tools.description: Grounded ChainLock recall at depth 0–5 (id+h+fh facts or refuse=no-stamp). Stamped vault facts — not Bayesian rank and not tip-only. Use this when you need stamped facts from the local vault, not a Bayesian ranking. Do not use it for adaptive memory ranking or reading only the live tip; use memory_r

tools.name: chainlock_verify
tools.description: Confirm fail-closed integrity of ChainLock chains and LOCKSET (LS-WP-0.1): broken prev, tip drift, missing GodLock cite. Integrity check — not a new seal. Use this when you must prove local chain integrity before trusting a recall. Do not use it for appending a stamp or sealing a new lockset; use ch

tools.name: chainlock_seal
tools.description: Write a new local LOCKSET over live chain tips (members {c,id,h,fh} + TemporalLock + GodLock cite, LS-WP-0.1). Not a raw-session close and not verify-only. Use this when the operator wants a new local lockset over current tips. Do not use it for verify-only, appending one fact, writing godlock.uk, o

tools.name: memory_observe
tools.description: Append the first memory_observation to the ChainLock learn chain (AKM-TRIAD-1.0). New fact in — not an outcome resolve and not a grounded ChainLock append. Posterior ≠ truth. Use this when you have a new fact to observe before resolve/calibrate. Do not use it for grounded ChainLock append without AK

tools.name: memory_resolve
tools.description: Append a memory_resolution outcome on an already-observed memory (AKM-TRIAD-1.0). UNKNOWN is distinct from MISS. Does not rewrite history. Use this when an observed memory_id or subject now has an outcome. Do not use it for first observation, calibration, or reading history; use memory_observe, memo

tools.name: memory_calibrate
tools.description: Calibrate one memory with the deterministic 3-of-4 triad plus Bayesian posterior (AKM-TRIAD-1.0). Writes a LEARN stamp — not a ranked search and not an explain view. Use this when an observed memory should receive a posterior after evidence, not a ranked search. Do not use it for observing a new fac

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Ranked adaptive recall after ChainLock verify (AKM-TRIAD-1.0). Belief list — not raw grounded stamps, not a public corpus cite, not one-id explain. Use this when you want a ranked belief list after verify, not raw grounded stamps. Do not use it for grounded ChainLock recall, library search, or expla

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Read one memory's stored explanation (node, history, or calibration: posterior, triad legs, effective N, Brier) — not a ranked list. Use this when you have a memory_id (or id) and need the stored explanation. Do not use it for ranked adaptive recall or appending an observation; use memory_recall or

tools.name: Softwares

Use this when an agent starts, or a hub refreshes the Software tab, and a slug is needed before fraggate_call. Do not use it for executing that slug, hashed live/stub discovery, or library papers; use fraggat

tools.name: runtime_bundle

tools.name: runtime_pull
tools.description: Open one hub product card by slug (name, version, skill, download, ops) — not FragGate live/stub status. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: runtime_skill, mesh_enable, mesh_disable, mesh_join, runtime_bundle · Private data: fraggate_list, fraggate_call, library_lookup, mesh_broadcast, chainlock_append, chainlock_tip, chainlock_recall, chainlock_seal, memory_get · Public sink: fraggate_list, fraggate_verify, fraggate_call, mesh_enable, mesh_disable, mesh_join, mesh_heartbeat, mesh_leave, mesh_broadcast, memory_resolve, memory_calibrate · Destructive: runtime_skill, fraggate_list, fraggate_describe, fraggate_verify, fraggate_call, decisiongate_check, mesh_status, mesh_disable, mesh_heartbeat, mesh_leave, runtime_bundle, runtime_pull, runtime_run, runtime_manifest, runtime_session_open, runtime_session_policy, runtime_session_exec, runtime_session_close.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: runtime_skill, mesh_enable, mesh_disable, mesh_join, runtime_bundle · Private data: fraggate_list, fraggate_call, library_lookup, mesh_broadcast, chainlock_append, chainlock_tip, chainlock_recall, chainlock_seal, memory_get · Public sink: fraggate_list, fraggate_verify, fraggate_call, mesh_enable, mesh_disable, mesh_join, mesh_heartbeat, mesh_leave, mesh_broadcast, memory_resolve, memory_calibrate · Destructive: runtime_skill, fraggate_list, fraggate_describe, fraggate_verify, fraggate_call, decisiongate_check, mesh_status, mesh_disable, mesh_heartbeat, mesh_leave, runtime_bundle, runtime_pull, runtime_run, runtime_manifest, runtime_session_open, runtime_session_policy, runtime_session_exec, runtime_session_close

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
